record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.context_brief: Maps into the free part of ergodic toral automorphisms
record.original_question: Let (T^d, R) be a toral automorphism that is ergodic for Lebesgue measure, and let (Y, S) be a homeomorphism of a Polish space with no invariant probability measure. Does there exist an equivariant Borel map from (Y, S) into the free part of (T^d, R)?

evidence.quote: Question 5.7. [10] Let (Td, R) be a toral automorphism which is ergodic for the Lebesgue measure. Let (Y, S) be a homeomorphism of a Polish space without any invariant probability measure. Is there an equivariant Borel map of (Y, S) into the free part of (Td, R)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 1$ and let $R \colon \mathbb{T}^d \to \mathbb{T}^d$ be a toral automorphism (induced by some $A \in \mathrm{GL}_d(\mathbb{Z})$) which is ergodic with respect to Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{T}^d$. Denote by $\mathrm{Free}(\mathbb{T}^d, R) = \{x \in \mathbb{T}^d : R^n x \neq x \text{ for all } n \in \mathbb{Z} \setminus \{0\}\}$ the free part of the $\mathbb{Z}$-action generated by $R$.

Let $Y$ be a Polish space and $S \colon Y \to Y$ a homeomorphism such that the dynamical system $(Y, S)$ admits no $S$-invariant Borel probability measure on $Y$.

A Borel map $\varphi \colon Y \to \mathbb{T}^d$ is called equivariant if $\varphi \circ S = R \circ \varphi$.

Question: Does there always exist an equivariant Borel map $\varphi \colon Y \to \mathbb{T}^d$ whose image is contained in $\mathrm{Free}(\mathbb{T}^d, R)$?
artifact.category_tag: Borel dynamics and descriptive set theory
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a survey on descriptive set theory and dynamical systems. Related work by Chandgotia–Meyerovitch identifies a "property F" on $\mathbb{Z}^d$-subshifts under which any free Borel system maps equivariantly into the free part, but no resolution for general ergodic toral automorphisms appears in available sources.

status_evidence.title: Borel factors and embeddings of systems in subshifts
status_evidence.snippet: property F is introduced on Z^d-shift spaces X under which there is an equivariant map from any free Borel action to the free part of X
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses analogous embedding questions for shift spaces but does not resolve the toral automorphism case.
